prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production website illustration for the central GameWake World stage
Input images: Image 1 is the approved UI composition reference; use only its circular illustrated world as composition and finish guidance, not its interface or text.
Primary request: Create one original circular fantasy survival-game world viewed from above, designed as the central "World" object in the GameWake landing page and Console. It should feel like a persistent shared place worth protecting, with forests, a small lake, cliffs, paths, a snowy upper region, a warm sandy region, and a few tiny settlement clearings. It must not reproduce a real Palworld map or identifiable copyrighted characters.
Style/medium: polished editorial game-map illustration, crisp readable land masses, hand-painted detail with restrained texture, no photorealism, no isometric block voxels.
Composition/framing: exact centered full circle, complete boundary visible, generous empty padding around the circle, no perspective tilt, no crop, no frame.
Color palette: natural greens, lake blue, stone gray and sand, harmonizing with #f4f5ef, #0b1020, #b8f43d and #606bf3.
Background: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for removal. Uniform color only, no shadow, gradient, texture, reflection, floor plane, glow or lighting variation.
Constraints: no text, no labels, no UI, no logos, no symbols, no people, no characters, no watermark. Do not use #ff00ff anywhere inside the world. Crisp opaque circular edge suitable for automatic background removal.
